part_1_hawkes.simulator: experiments/m5_02/design.json causal section, examples/hawkes_days.rs; base rates, decays, weights, diffusion, spread and kernel unchanged; made-up

impact_step.rule: the policy's own setting or the next higher: 0 to 0.25, 0.25 to 1, 1 to 2

perturbations.grid: product in the listed order, 24 points per setting, the unperturbed point first; ties take the first in grid order
perturbations.plausibility: bounds are #108's ranges; branching_scale multiplies every weight and each point must keep the branching matrix's spectral radius below 1, checked and recorded by code before any day is generated; a failing point is removed and reported
perturbations.identifiability: on the selection days of each point, with no policy: realised market-order rate over the unperturbed rate within 10 % of the multiplier implied, and the regression slope of mid change on signed market orders within 10 % of impact_ticks; a failing point is reported and removed before freeze

part_1_hawkes.fixed_stress: market 2, limit 0.7, branching 1.2, next higher impact

adversary.picks: for each policy (the seeds of a learned arm being one policy), the point with the largest mean daily loss over its selection days; a tail statistic is not used since 10 days do not resolve one
adversary.information: parameters set before a day; sees nothing of its path; changes neither matching, accounting nor limits
adversary.used_on: selection days only; the holdout is not used by it

arms.classical: fixed spread and Avellaneda-Stoikov at #107 part C's points selected on its validation days per setting
arms.learned: #107 part C's frozen mlp and lstm, seeds 1 to 5, in every setting (validation chose mlp at impact 0 and lstm at the other two as control); HSN and the other arms left out for compute, stated

part_1_hawkes.no_training: learned arms are loaded and verified by sha256 against #107's manifest and evaluated deterministically; this study trains nothing
part_1_hawkes.execution: #107 part C's: queue_position_rational, 1 lot per 500 ms, no minimum time; same fees (-0.0001, secondary 0.0002), limits, latency for every arm
conditions: adversary at the policy's own selected point
impact only (next higher impact, flow unperturbed)
metrics: margin-rs maintenance requirement at the day's peak position, reported as a requirement
part_1_hawkes.margin_shortfall: not measured: this simulator has no declared capital and none is made up; margin-rs#7 gives a requirement, not a capital

intervals.kind: paired 90 % moving block bootstrap over holdout days of the daily difference
intervals.pairs: each arm stressed against itself unperturbed, and against no-trade under the same condition

part_1_hawkes.reading: descriptive, per arm and setting. A loss is reported as a loss; an interval containing 0 is 'no difference shown', never equivalence or robustness; no adopt decision
part_1_hawkes.once: the holdout runs once from a frozen manifest, behind an O_EXCL marker claimed before any day is read, with a frozen_sha256 check and at most 1 recorded recovery

part_2_281_impact.what: #281's condition declared and not run: its A and B frozen models (10 models, seeds 1 to 5) at kappa = 2 kappa0 per regime through #282's reactive runner
part_2_281_impact.days: #281's 30 holdout days, seed offset 300000, and its train-only kappa0
part_2_281_impact.gated_on: #282's runner merged on main; otherwise reported not run, nothing replaces it
part_2_281_impact.disclosure: those base days were already read for #281's other 13 conditions, so this is a one-off added condition; it has no bearing on #281's decision and is reported apart
part_2_281_impact.intervals: #281's paired stratified stationary block bootstrap, 2000 replicates, seed 281

compute.stop_rule: if the pilot projects over the ceiling, stop and report before selection and cut in this order: drop impact_low, then lstm; no seed cut. During a step, stop at 1.5 x its pilot-based estimate or at the ceiling, and report
